Start with the back of the jar rather than the front slogan. In Mumbai the weekday cup is usually milk coffee from an office pantry. Ultra Blend is 70% coffee and 30% chicory. ### A plain definition

## How do you read the chicory line on the jar?

Flip the jar over and look for the ingredient line. If it lists chicory, that jar is a blend — not pure coffee.
